tooltips.burnRate: How much cash your business spends each month beyond what it earns.
tooltips.runway: How many months your business can continue operating with current cash reserves and spending.
tooltips.liquidity: Whether your business can cover its short-term bills with the cash and receivables it has now.
tooltips.receivables: Money owed to your business by customers that has not been collected yet.
tooltips.currentRatio: A measure of your ability to pay short-term obligations. Below 1.0 means your short-term debts exceed your available assets.
tooltips.debtToRevenue: How much total debt your business carries compared to what it earns. A higher ratio means heavier debt burden.

NEGATIVE_CASH_FLOW.title: Negative Cash Flow
NEGATIVE_CASH_FLOW.whatHappened: Your business spent more than it earned last month.
NEGATIVE_CASH_FLOW.whyMatters: Sustained negative cash flow drains your reserves and can force you to take on debt or cut operations.
NEGATIVE_CASH_FLOW.howSerious: Your net loss was ฿{netProfit} on ฿{revenue} revenue. Total expenses reached ฿{totalExpenses}.
NEGATIVE_CASH_FLOW.whatNext: Review your largest expense categories and consider whether any costs can be reduced or deferred.

LOW_RUNWAY.title: Low Cash Runway
LOW_RUNWAY.whatHappened: Your cash reserves can only sustain operations for {runwayMonths} months at the current spending rate.
LOW_RUNWAY.whyMatters: A runway below 3 months leaves almost no time to react to unexpected costs or revenue drops.
LOW_RUNWAY.howSerious: You have ฿{cashReserve} in reserves against a monthly burn of ฿{monthlyBurn}.
LOW_RUNWAY.whatNext: Consider reducing non-essential expenses or exploring ways to increase revenue to extend your runway.

EXPENSE_GROWTH.title: Rapid Expense Growth
EXPENSE_GROWTH.whatHappened: Your total expenses grew by {growthRate}% compared to the previous month.
EXPENSE_GROWTH.whyMatters: Expenses rising faster than revenue squeeze your margins and may lead to cash flow problems.
EXPENSE_GROWTH.whatNext: Identify which expense categories grew the most and determine if the increase is temporary or structural.

HIGH_PAYROLL.title: High Payroll Ratio
HIGH_PAYROLL.whatHappened: Payroll costs represent {payrollRatio}% of your monthly revenue.
HIGH_PAYROLL.whyMatters: When payroll exceeds 50% of revenue, it leaves little room for other operating costs and profit.
HIGH_PAYROLL.howSerious: Payroll is ฿{payrollAmount} against ฿{revenue} in revenue.
HIGH_PAYROLL.whatNext: Evaluate whether each role directly contributes to revenue growth or if some work can be automated.

HIGH_RECEIVABLES.title: High Outstanding Receivables
HIGH_RECEIVABLES.whatHappened: Uncollected customer payments represent {receivablesRatio}% of your revenue.
HIGH_RECEIVABLES.whyMatters: High receivables tie up cash that could be used for operations, and some may never be collected.
HIGH_RECEIVABLES.howSerious: You have ฿{receivables} in outstanding receivables against ฿{revenue} in monthly revenue.
HIGH_RECEIVABLES.whatNext: Follow up on overdue invoices and consider tightening payment terms for future orders.

LOW_LIQUIDITY.title: Low Liquidity
LOW_LIQUIDITY.whatHappened: Your current ratio is {currentRatio}, meaning short-term debts exceed available assets.
LOW_LIQUIDITY.whyMatters: A ratio below 1.0 means you may not be able to cover upcoming bills without borrowing.
LOW_LIQUIDITY.howSerious: Current assets are ฿{currentAssets} against ฿{currentLiabilities} in short-term liabilities.
LOW_LIQUIDITY.whatNext: Focus on collecting receivables faster and deferring non-urgent purchases to improve your liquidity position.

INCOMPLETE_DATA.title: Insufficient Historical Data
INCOMPLETE_DATA.whatHappened: Only {snapshotCount} of the recommended {requiredCount} monthly snapshots have been recorded.
INCOMPLETE_DATA.whyMatters: Without enough history, trends cannot be detected and some risk rules cannot run properly.
INCOMPLETE_DATA.howSerious: Certain risk assessments are marked as incomplete rather than absent. More data improves accuracy.
INCOMPLETE_DATA.whatNext: Add more monthly financial snapshots to build a complete picture of your business trends.

DECLINING_GROWTH.title: Declining Revenue Growth
DECLINING_GROWTH.whatHappened: Revenue growth rate dropped to {revenueGrowthRate}%, down from {previousGrowthRate}%.
DECLINING_GROWTH.whyMatters: Declining growth makes it harder to cover rising costs and may signal weakening demand.
DECLINING_GROWTH.howSerious: Your business is growing slower than before, which can impact long-term sustainability.
DECLINING_GROWTH.whatNext: Analyze which products or services are underperforming and explore new market opportunities.

HIGH_DEBT_RATIO.title: High Debt-to-Revenue Ratio
HIGH_DEBT_RATIO.whatHappened: Your total debt is {debtToRevenueRatio}x your monthly revenue.
HIGH_DEBT_RATIO.whyMatters: A high debt ratio increases interest costs and limits your ability to borrow for growth opportunities.
HIGH_DEBT_RATIO.howSerious: Total debt of ฿{totalDebt} against monthly revenue of ฿{annualRevenue}.
HIGH_DEBT_RATIO.whatNext: Prioritize paying down high-interest debt and avoid taking on new loans unless absolutely necessary.

hero.description: Wallflower turns your business data into clear diagnostics, risk warnings, and decision simulations—so you can act with evidence instead of guesswork.

workflow.title: Three steps to a better decision
workflow.step01Desc: Wallflower calculates your business health from real numbers — revenue trends, expense ratios, cash runway, and working capital.
workflow.step02Desc: Test decisions before committing. Run what-if scenarios for hiring, pricing, marketing spend, or equipment purchases.
workflow.step03Desc: Compare outcomes side-by-side, understand the risks, and move forward with evidence backing your decision.

scenarios.title: Scenarios you can simulate
scenarios.description: Every business decision carries risk. Wallflower lets you test the numbers before committing real resources.
scenarios.hireDesc: See how additional salary costs impact cash flow, break-even timeline, and monthly burn rate.
scenarios.priceDesc: Model the revenue and margin effect of raising or lowering prices across your product lines.
scenarios.marketingDesc: Estimate the ROI timeline and cash impact of allocating budget to a marketing campaign.
scenarios.equipmentDesc: Compare buying vs leasing, understand depreciation effects, and plan around cash reserves.
scenarios.paymentDesc: Assess the working capital impact when a key customer delays payment by 30, 60, or 90 days.

explainability.title: Your numbers, calculated. Not predicted.
explainability.description: Wallflower separates deterministic math from AI interpretation. You always know which is which.
explainability.calculatedDesc: Deterministic formulas produce exact, reproducible results from your business data.
explainability.aiDesc: AI reads the calculated results and explains them in context — it never calculates financial values.

thaiSme.title: Built for Thai small businesses
thaiSme.description: We understand the challenges Thai SMEs face every day. Wallflower is designed to address them directly.
thaiSme.cashFlowSolution: Real-time cash runway tracking with early warnings when reserves run thin.
thaiSme.noCfoSolution: Wallflower does the financial analysis so you can focus on running your business.
thaiSme.fatigueSolution: Side-by-side scenario comparison takes the guesswork out of major decisions.
thaiSme.digitalSolution: Simple interface that works like a conversation, not a spreadsheet.
thaiSme.healthSolution: Diagnostics and KPIs that show your business standing at a glance.

cta.title: Start understanding your business
cta.description: Turn uncertainty into evidence. Make your next decision with clarity, not guesswork.
